title: 在线选举
summary: 按时间给出投票人，查询任意给定时刻当时领先者；票数并列时最近获得选票者领先。
insight: 构造时按票顺序维护计数与当前领先者，把每个时刻的领先者存下；查询二分最后一个不晚于 t 的投票时刻。
pitfalls: 并列使用大于等于更新领先者
查询 t 保证不早于首票时间

solutions.title: 前缀领先者与时间二分
solutions.idea: 预计算每次投票后的领先者以常数读取查询结果。
steps: 构造时 counts[person]++；若新票数>=leader 票数则 leader=person，leaders[i]=leader
q(t) 二分第一个 times[index]>t 的位置

code.java: class TopVotedCandidate { private final int[] times,leaders;public TopVotedCandidate(int[] persons,int[] times){this.times=times;leaders=new int[persons.length];Map<Integer,Integer> counts=new HashMap<>();int leader=-1,leaderVotes=0;for(int i=0;i<persons.length;i++){int votes=counts.merge(persons[i],1,Integer::sum);if(votes>=leaderVotes){leader=persons[i];leaderVotes=votes;}leaders[i]=leader;}}public int q(int t){int low=0,high=times.length;while(low<high){int middle=low+(high-low)/2;if(times[middle]<=t)low=middle+1;else high=middle;}return leaders[low-1];} }
code.kotlin: class TopVotedCandidate(persons:IntArray,private val times:IntArray){private val leaders=IntArray(persons.size);init{val counts=mutableMapOf<Int,Int>();var leader=-1;var leaderVotes=0;for(i in persons.indices){val votes=(counts[persons[i]]?:0)+1;counts[persons[i]]=votes;if(votes>=leaderVotes){leader=persons[i];leaderVotes=votes};leaders[i]=leader}};fun q(t:Int):Int{var low=0;var high=times.size;while(low<high){val middle=low+(high-low)/2;if(times[middle]<=t)low=middle+1 else high=middle};return leaders[low-1]} }
code.cpp: class TopVotedCandidate { vector<int> times,leaders;public:TopVotedCandidate(vector<int>& persons,vector<int>& inputTimes):times(inputTimes),leaders(persons.size()){unordered_map<int,int> counts;int leader=-1,leaderVotes=0;for(int i=0;i<(int)persons.size();++i){int votes=++counts[persons[i]];if(votes>=leaderVotes){leader=persons[i];leaderVotes=votes;}leaders[i]=leader;}}int q(int t){int index=upper_bound(times.begin(),times.end(),t)-times.begin()-1;return leaders[index];} };
